summary: Add account-aware connection preflight plus verified per-channel Windows Chrome profile binding without copying browser or provider credentials.

tasks.source_instruction: Persist a globally unique immutable profile slot only after a one-time owner state and verified provider callback complete atomically.
Reject expired, consumed, foreign, conflicting and malformed slots; preserve disconnect and exact-account reconnect without allowing normal OAuth to steal a binding.
Show the current profile state and route selected A/B, pending new and legacy channels to the correct isolated Chrome directory without automatic OAuth.
Accept only fixed-origin canonical UUID protocol requests, reuse an authoritative slot, preserve legacy channel directories and reject arbitrary URLs, paths, flags and commands.
Run preflight, native, client, binding and read-only fixture regressions from the canonical v0.20.71 gate; keep unrelated baseline commerce debt explicit.
